uutiset.t: Poland Warns on Tech Debt Flood Before 2027 Eurobond Sales
uutiset.s: Poland is planning to tap international markets in early 2027 even as it warned of a flood of corporate borrowing clamoring for investor attention.

uutiset.t: As the AI Storm Rages, Are UK and Europe Markets a Haven For Investors? Live Q&A
uutiset.s: Bloomberg reporters take your questions about UK and European markets in a Live Q&A on Tuesday, December 1 at 1 p.m. GMT

uutiset.t: Bank Indonesia Says 2027 Focus to Be on Stability, Inflation
uutiset.s: Bank Indonesia will stay focused on stability next year as it pursues monetary policy that keeps inflation within its target range, while confronting sustained pressure on the rupiah.

uutiset.t: El Niño, Flooding Put Squeeze on South African Fruit Producers
uutiset.s: South Africa’s high-value fruit exports are under pressure due to adverse weather ranging from winter floods to heat waves linked to the El Niño weather phenomenon, with growers cutting harvest forecasts for grapes and stone fruit.

uutiset.t: Turkey’s Tightening Steps Show Early Signs of Calming Markets
uutiset.s: Turkey’s latest steps to tighten financial conditions are showing early signs of bringing stability to the country’s turbulent markets and slowing the unwind in popular carry trades.

uutiset.t: Ofwat Warns Thames Water Rescue Decision Remains Months Away
uutiset.s: The UK’s water regulator has warned it is still months away from making a decision on whether to approve a rescue of Thames Water by its creditors.

uutiset.t: ¿Volverá la derecha al poder en España?
uutiset.s: España vota tras casi tres años de enorme tensión. Las encuestas apuntan a un regreso de la derecha, pero en 2023 también lo hicieron y Pedro Sánchez logró mantenerse en el poder. ¿Qué está en juego esta vez? (Source: Bloomberg)

uutiset.t: Europe Has Too Much Wind, Not Enough Power Grid
uutiset.s: The continent is adding renewable electricity faster than the infrastructure needed to move it, leaving consumers to pay the price.

uutiset.t: Stock Futures Rally as AI Trade Gathers Pace; EU Budget Talks Falter
uutiset.s: US investors return from the holiday with a rally in equity futures as a tech recovery gains momentum. EU leaders cut budget talks short after failing to negotiate a long-term funding plan. Shoppers prepare for Black Friday as retailers navigate higher fuel costs and consumers tightening their belts

uutiset.t: Polish President Blocks Pre-Election Tax Cut in New Blow to Tusk
uutiset.s: Polish President Karol Nawrocki blocked legislation that would’ve cut personal income taxes, in a fresh blow to Donald Tusk’s efforts to deliver financial relief for some voters before next year’s general ballot.

uutiset.t: India’s Richest Civic Body Will Open Bond Sales to Retail Buyers
uutiset.s: Mumbai’s civic authority, India’s richest, plans to tap individual investors through future bond sales to help finance urban infrastructure projects.

uutiset.t: Deutsche Boerse’s €5.3 billion Allfunds Bid Gets EU Approval
uutiset.s: Deutsche Boerse AG’s €5.3 billion ($5.8 billion) deal for Allfunds Group Plc has won European Union unconditional approval, paving the way for the largest acquisition in the German exchange operator’s history.

uutiset.t: Altria’s Interest in Imperial May Affect Its AB InBev Stake
uutiset.s: A possible three-way deal to reshape the global tobacco industry may spill over into another business whose products are sometimes consumed alongside cigarettes — beer.

uutiset.t: Nasdaq Futures Rally as Traders Pile Into Battered AI Stocks
uutiset.s: US stock futures rose, indicating the market is poised to rebound as dip buyers scoop up beaten down technology shares.

uutiset.t: China Drives Biggest Stock Gain Since 2024 With Rare Midday Vow
uutiset.s: Chinese authorities gave markets a boost with a rare midday statement pledging support, sending stocks to their best day in more than two years.
